assertions: Origin download works with no volunteers
Explicit opt-in starts a bounded volunteer; no automatic traffic claim
Real WebRTC payload passes hash verification without another origin file request
Opting out while discovery is pending never starts a peer request
A corrupted peer payload is discarded and retried at the Authority
Stopping a booster clears its cache and downloads fall back to origin
A volunteer leaving during transfer still completes the original download
Account/server switches retire consent and local contribution counters
Private-access enable and disable refresh a complete status without granting an empty allow-list
Admin health and private-access port controls render without horizontal overflow
